mapper.select: select m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where m.match_data = #{targetDate} and s.settlement_status = '정산대기' order by match_date desc;

select m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where m.match_data = #{targetDate} and s.settlement_status = '지급완료' order by match_date desc;
select settled_at from personal_settlement order by settled_at desc;
